name: NomadMD Segment v2 Tracking Plan — server stream
description: NomadMD Segment integration v2, server-stream events (schema_version 2.0) — attach to your Node.js source. Matches the "Segment v2 — Event & Schema Reference" documentation. Import into your workspace via Segment's Public API (Tracking Plans), or use as a JSON Schema reference. Generated — do not edit.

signup_marketplace_id.description: brand first signed up through — set once, NOT a 'belongs to'

client_profile_id.description: primary care record (legacy typo clientProfielId fixed)

client_profile_ids.description: all care records under the account

package_credits_remaining.description: current unexpired credit balance on the account — point-in-time state for segmentation (churn-risk/upsell audiences); the ledger is the events (grants on Membership Started/Renewed + Package Purchased, burns on Package Credit Redeemed). Brand-scoped at the receiving source: credits from THIS brand's packages only

lifetime_appointments.description: Account-grain lifetime appointment count, computed within your brand only.

lifetime_revenue.description: Account-grain lifetime revenue, computed within your brand only.

is_new_customer.description: POINT-IN-TIME STATE: lifetime_appointments == 0. False immediately after the first booking — BY DESIGN. 'Was this customer new at the time of appointment X' is answered by the EVENT properties is_new_customer / prior_appointment_count, never by this trait

profile_ids.description: all staff profiles.id under this user (one per organization) — the reverse of practitioner_user_id on events; lets practitioner_profile_id join back to this usr_ identity (one user -> many profiles)

jsonSchema.description: Auth success — triggers identify() + alias(anonymousId -> mu_) on client
New marketplace_user registered — exactly ONE group-scoped identify(); signup_marketplace_id trait set once

Booking submitted — the canonical conversion. Fires at request submission as booked value; kept honest by Order Updated / Order Cancelled, with cash truth in the payment-ledger events. Also emitted standalone for membership/package purchases and renewals (order_id membership_<id> / package_<id>) — never doubled when bundled inside a booking checkout.

created_via.description: Origin surface of the creation: consumer checkout, admin dashboard, field app, or API.

created_by.description: actor TYPE who created it — patient for self-serve, staff type otherwise; complements created_via (surface)

created_by_user_id.description: staff users.id when staff-created; omitted for patient self-serve — the event userId already identifies the creator

checkout_session_id.description: PRESENT AND NULLABLE on the server stream from day one (phase 1 emits null until the client pass-through ships in phase 2); non-null on client stream

amount_due_now.description: what checkout displayed as due at booking

prior_appointment_count.description: Prior appointments for this customer at your brand, counted before the current one.

is_group_appointment.description: true when this order books >1 patient on a shared group checkout; server always emits

group_id.description: UUID shared by the group's appointments; null for solo

group_size.description: patients on the shared checkout (1 for solo); revenue/total are the group total, not per-member

checkout_session_id.description: null on server stream until phase-2 pass-through, same as Order Completed

jsonSchema.description: Membership becomes ACTIVE on the patient account — FIRST transition to active, REGARDLESS of charge outcome. Anchored at the model-layer status transition, not the charge engine. The standalone ecommerce Order Completed (order_id membership_<id>) still fires ONLY on an actual successful standalone charge — money truth unchanged.

charged_at_start.description: true when the activation charge succeeded; false for admin assignment with balance owed / deferred payment

created_via.description: Origin surface of the creation: consumer checkout, admin dashboard, field app, or API.

package_id.description: the package granted by this membership cycle — a membership is a recurring package; the grant is FULFILLMENT of the membership charge, so it emits NO Package Purchased and NO second ecommerce order

credits_granted.description: credits/points assigned to the account this cycle

credits_expire_at.description: expiration of this cycle's granted credits

jsonSchema.description: Recurring charge succeeds — and the cycle's package credits are granted
Any transition to cancelled/expired — customer cancel, admin cancel, dunning exhaustion, or expiry.

created_via.description: Origin surface of the creation: consumer checkout, admin dashboard, field app, or API.

created_by.description: actor TYPE who created it — patient for self-serve, staff type otherwise; complements created_via (surface)

created_by_user_id.description: staff users.id when staff-created; omitted for patient self-serve — the event userId already identifies the creator

time_to_approval_minutes.description: minutes from request createdAt to the approval transition

jsonSchema.description: Pre-fulfillment request edit (procedures, constraints, patient, location) — slim change_set mirror of Appointment Updated. MONEY RULE: when the change affects booked value (procedures, location/travel fee), ALSO emit Order Updated with the preview-priced previous/new amounts. Keyed to the POST-edit request owner (patient changes included in change_set).

change_set.description: field names only: procedures, time_constraints, practitioner_constraints, organization_constraints, patient, location

time_to_fulfill_minutes.description: minutes from request createdAt to the fulfilled transition — end-to-end, INCLUDES any approval wait (subtract time_to_approval_minutes for post-approval fulfillment time)

jsonSchema.description: Appointment reaches booked. Fires ONCE per booking (legacy re-emitted on visit-start and reset; v2 uses Appointment Started / specific events instead)

created_via.description: Origin surface of the creation: consumer checkout, admin dashboard, field app, or API.

created_by.description: actor TYPE who created it — patient for self-serve, staff type otherwise; complements created_via (surface)

created_by_user_id.description: staff users.id when staff-created; omitted for patient self-serve — the event userId already identifies the creator

practitioner_user_id.description: usr_<users.id> of the practitioner (profiles.user_id) — joins practitioner_profile_id to the user_staff identity (the event userId is the patient). Null when the profile has no login (forward-only enrichment)

is_group_appointment.description: true when booked on a shared group checkout

group_size.description: patients on the shared checkout (1 for solo); revenue/total are the group total

old_practitioner_user_id.description: usr_<users.id> of old_practitioner_profile_id — see practitioner_user_id on Appointment Booked

new_practitioner_user_id.description: usr_<users.id> of new_practitioner_profile_id — see practitioner_user_id on Appointment Booked

jsonSchema.description: Other edits (location/notes) — slim change_set, NOT the legacy firehose; reschedules/reassignments/payments fire their own events

change_set.description: field names that changed — values omitted

jsonSchema.description: Visit started. (The legacy integration re-emitted 'Appointment Booked' here; v2 fires this dedicated event instead.)

practitioner_user_id.description: usr_<users.id> of the practitioner — see Appointment Booked

jsonSchema.description: Appointment completed — the revenue-recognition moment, carrying the delivered procedures and the full realized money breakdown. Never carries chart-note bodies; has_chart_notes indicates whether notes were recorded.

practitioner_user_id.description: usr_<users.id> of the practitioner — see Appointment Booked

is_group_appointment.description: true when completed on a shared group checkout

group_size.description: patients on the shared checkout (1 for solo)

refund_amount.description: cash refunded for THIS cancellation. For a partial group cancel (is_partial_group_cancel=true) this is the group's overpayment after voiding only this member's charges — NOT the whole-checkout refund

is_group_appointment.description: true when the cancelled appointment belongs to a group

group_size.description: patients in the group at cancel time

is_partial_group_cancel.description: true when ≥1 sibling survives, so the shared checkout is reduced by this member's subtotal rather than torn down

jsonSchema.description: Appointment returned to booked (typically completed -> booked). Status dashboards should return the appointment to the booked bucket; Appointment Booked is not re-emitted.
No-show recorded (NET-NEW — legacy has no noshow tracking path at all)

order_id.description: = appointment_request_id (or membership_<id>/package_<id> for standalone orders) — direct rollup to Order Completed without the warehouse join through checkout_id (v2.2); omitted when the checkout resolves to no order

is_group_appointment.description: true when the charged checkout serves a group

is_split_payment.description: true when the checkout has >1 payment link, i.e. the bill is split across payers

payment_link_id.description: payment_links.id this charge settled (payment_method=payment_link only); null for card/cash

active_payment_link_count.description: payment links currently on the checkout — split-payment fan-out

order_id.description: direct order rollup — see Payment Captured (v2.2); omitted when the checkout resolves to no order

is_group_appointment.description: true when the refunded order is a group checkout

jsonSchema.description: Booked value changed after the order — checkout edits post-fulfillment (services changed on-site, line items edited) AND pre-fulfillment request edits that reprice the order. Keeps the booked-value view honest

is_group_appointment.description: true when the repriced order is a group checkout

jsonSchema.description: Order terminally cancelled before delivery (request rejected or cancelled, or appointment cancelled) — reverses the booked value. A replacement booking is always a new order with a new order_id.

is_group_appointment.description: true when the reversed order is a group checkout

jsonSchema.description: A pending request is dispatched (fanned out) to candidate practitioners as pending offer-appointments. Fires ONCE per dispatch round/wave — the supply-funnel denominator for offered -> accepted/declined/no-response. Each rank wave is its own round (rank 1 pool first; on exhaustion the rank 2 wave fires a new event with dispatch_round 2). Per-nurse responses are Appointment Request Accepted / Declined; no-response is the ABSENCE of a response before the round closes (round closes at whichever comes first: Appointment Request Fulfilled, the next Appointment Offered, or Appointment Request Cancelled — no explicit close event). NOT Appointment Assigned (assignment happens on accept). Keyed to the request owner (patient userId).

dispatch_round.description: 1-based wave counter per request; replaces is_redispatch (round > 1)

rank.description: provider rank tier this wave targeted, when rank-based dispatch

offer_count.description: number of candidate practitioners this dispatch round was offered to

practitioner_profile_ids.description: the candidate practitioners offered this round — the per-nurse denominator for accept/decline/no-response rates

practitioner_user_ids.description: usr_<users.id> per candidate, POSITION-ALIGNED with practitioner_profile_ids (null where a profile has no login) — joins the offer pool to user_staff identities

organization_count.description: distinct organizations in the candidate pool this round

dispatch_round.description: which offer wave this acceptance belongs to (per-rank funnels)

time_to_accept_minutes.description: provider pickup latency: minutes from the offer reaching providers until practitioner acceptance. Anchor = the approval transition when requires_approval (approved requests are then sent to providers), else request createdAt (no approval gate — offered immediately). NOT anchored at createdAt for approval-gated requests; that would duplicate time_to_fulfill_minutes

jsonSchema.description: Practitioner declines (fires per declining practitioner — the denominator of per-nurse acceptance rate alongside Appointment Request Accepted)

offers_outstanding.description: pending candidate offers remaining AFTER this decline — answers 'is the request still out to anyone?' without a join; 0 = round exhausted (escalation/re-dispatch follows)

dispatch_round.description: which offer wave this response belongs to (per-rank funnels)

practitioner_user_id.description: usr_<users.id> of the assigned practitioner — see Appointment Booked. Here it equals the event userId (the event is keyed on the accepter), made explicit so joins never rely on that coincidence

jsonSchema.description: Assessment/intervention form saved during a visit — an activity signal that never carries clinical content.

repeat_until_at.description: the repeat rule's 'until' — present only when is_recurring is true; null = repeats indefinitely

order_id.description: direct order rollup — see Payment Captured (v2.2); omitted when the checkout resolves to no order

is_group_appointment.description: true when collected against a group checkout

is_split_payment.description: true when the checkout has >1 payment link

active_payment_link_count.description: payment links currently on the checkout

jsonSchema.description: Marketplace integration changed (including THIS Segment config)
